name: Autumn-red rowan sapling 011
prompt: a tough windbent shrub whose trunk kinks hard sideways then turns up, its bare gripping roots clenched around a single small stone at its base, an organic RAGGED IRREGULAR silhouette with leaves and strands trailing off unevenly at the edges and a torn uneven bottom — never a rectangle, never a straight edge, never a filled panel or square sheet, no hard border of any kind — ONLY the plant itself, isolated on a fully transparent background, NO rock, NO cliff, NO stone wall, NO mountain, NO ground, nothing behind it, autumn-red rowan sapling, hanging almost upside down, tall, about three times human height, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_1.glow_concept: light in the crack at its root

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the small fire at the foot of the tree flickers. It is lit and clearly visible in every frame, including the first. It stays exactly the same size and shape in every frame: it never grows and never spreads, only its brightness shifts. Nothing is added or removed anywhere: every object appears in every frame, the same number of them, in the same places, at the same size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour, no outline redrawn. The last frame matches the first exactly.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
